identification: Stihl FS 85 brushcutter (25.4cc 2-stroke, PRO series sticker), bike/cowhorn handle, AutoCut-style line head and grass guard, harness, plus orange spare deflector/guard and green 5L fuel can. Used, tank discoloured, looks complete. Catalogue: estimate A$80-120; current bid A$100 at 10 Nov. Google: the FS 85 is a discontinued (legacy) 25.4cc 0.95 kW pro-grade Stihl brushcutter; bike-handle version is the FS 85 (T), loop-handle FS 85 R. Current Stihl equivalents retail around A$700-800 new (stihl.com.au shows a petrol brushcutter at A$699; a Gumtree seller quotes RRP A$800).
